articles.headline: U.S. accuses Chinese AI firms of copying American AI technology
articles.summary: The U.S. government accused Chinese AI companies of maliciously copying technology from American firms, raising the risk of tighter export controls and broader geopolitical friction. Businesses exposed to AI supply chains, cross-border data flows, or China-related tech procurement should watch for compliance and sourcing impacts.

articles.headline: Qualcomm strikes AI chip deal with Amazon, with stock purchase rights
articles.summary: Qualcomm said Amazon could buy up to $60 billion of its AI data-center chips and related products under a long-term partnership. The deal matters for businesses because it signals stronger competition in AI infrastructure and may influence future cloud and chip pricing.

articles.headline: Cognition AI raises $2 billion at $48 billion valuation
articles.summary: Cognition AI secured a major funding round at a sharply higher valuation, underscoring investor appetite for AI coding tools. For companies, that suggests faster product development, more automation in software teams, and stronger pressure to adopt AI-assisted engineering workflows.
